profiles.label: Heltec MeshTower V2 - microSD + internal (SD primary)

unavailableProfiles.label: Heltec MeshTower V2 - historical internal-only profile
unavailableProfiles.reason: Retired from normal releases in favor of the combined SD/internal profile. Existing internal-only bootloaders require a one-time local installation of the normal combined image via USB/BLE DFU or SWD; do not use a cross-profile LoRa update.

blockers: Installed internal-only identity requires local migration, not cross-profile LoRa self-update.

unavailableProfiles.label: GAT562 Mesh Watch13
unavailableProfiles.reason: A watch-specific QSPI source port avoids driving the vibration motor as an LED. It awaits physical power, DFU and update qualification; no verified download is available.

blockers: Physical button, motor-off, flash and power-loss update qualification.

unavailableProfiles.label: Heltec Mesh Solar
unavailableProfiles.reason: A guarded internal-staging Solar source port avoids conflicting LED/QSPI/rail definitions, preserves the real factory identity and services the author-confirmed watchdog. Carrier-revision power/reset and long DFU/update watchdog behavior still require hardware qualification. No verified download is available.

blockers: Carrier revision, factory entry, power/reset and long DFU/apply watchdog waveform qualification.
Matching internal-staging S140 6.1.1 exact-base delta and signed self-update failure/power-loss qualification.
External staging remains unsupported: actual flash/rail routing conflicts with BSP BMS/indicator definitions.

unavailableProfiles.label: LilyGo T-Impulse Plus
unavailableProfiles.reason: A dedicated QSPI source port preserves T-Impulse Plus flash wiring, rail and controls. Physical flash, power, DFU and update qualification is still required; no verified download is available.

blockers: Physical flash-rail, button, USB/BLE and power-loss update qualification.

unavailableProfiles.label: LilyGo T-Echo Card
unavailableProfiles.reason: A Card-specific QSPI source port preserves its NFC configuration, flash rail and controls. Physical flash, USB/BLE and update qualification is still required; no verified download is available.

blockers: Physical NFC, flash-rail, button, USB/BLE and power-loss update qualification.

unavailableProfiles.label: Meshtiny
unavailableProfiles.reason: A dedicated Meshtiny QSPI source port preserves factory identity and real side/top controls. Physical flash, power, DFU and update qualification remains pending; no verified download is available.

blockers: Physical side/top-button entry, flash and power-loss update qualification.
Matching application must use external raw staging; application flash macros cannot be inferred from the bootloader.

unavailableProfiles.label: MeshTracker X1
unavailableProfiles.reason: A dedicated internal-staging S140-v7 qualification source port preserves factory USB identity and the active-high button without driving unverified flash or peripheral rails. Cold USB/reset/power behavior and matching internal-staging application updates still need hardware testing. No verified download is available.

blockers: Cold USB, button-plus-USB, BLE, timeout and power-controller behavior during lengthy updates.
Matching internal-staging S140 7.3.0 application, exact-base delta and signed exact-profile self-update qualification.
External full-image staging remains unsupported until flash-rail/reset behavior is corroborated.

unavailableProfiles.label: Muzi Base
unavailableProfiles.reason: A Muzi Base QSPI source port covers the four carrier variants with the real factory identity, LED polarity and flash pins. Physical DFU, flash and update qualification remains pending; no verified download is available.

blockers: Physical carrier-variant, flash, USB/BLE and power-loss update qualification.

unavailableProfiles.label: Nano G2 Ultra
unavailableProfiles.reason: A dedicated Nano G2 Ultra QSPI source port preserves designer-confirmed flash/buttons and factory USB identity. Physical single-button DFU, flash and update qualification is pending; no verified download is available.

blockers: Physical single-button USB/BLE entry, flash and power-loss update qualification.

unavailableProfiles.label: ThinkNode M4
unavailableProfiles.reason: M4 has a bespoke PCB and manufacturer-specified 2 MB external flash, but verified flash routing, factory bootloader identity and safe power/reset behavior are missing. An M3 profile or guessed internal-only definition is unsafe.

blockers: Factory USB descriptor, INFO_UF2 board identity and bootloader installation route.
Actual 2 MB external-flash pin routing.
Safe power/reset/rail behavior.

unavailableProfiles.label: ThinkNode M8
unavailableProfiles.reason: A V0.3 QSPI compile-only source port exists, but its factory USB identity and disputed power pin are unresolved. Its zero USB identity is an invalid compiler fixture, not a flashable image. No verified download is available.

blockers: Factory USB descriptor and INFO_UF2 board identity; replace invalid zero identity before any hardware use.
Resolve P0.13 power-enable versus I2C rail and production hardware revision.
Physical power/entry, flash and interrupted update qualification.

unavailableProfiles.label: Seeed Wio WM1110
unavailableProfiles.reason: This target is the Wio WM1110 Dev Kit (SDK carrier), not Tracker 1110 or XIAO. Official installation is J-Link/SWD and its connector is CH340C USB-UART, not proven native-USB UF2. The official blank application starts at address zero, not an identified Adafruit factory bootloader layout. Exact bootloader/SoftDevice identity, UART recovery and NFC configuration still need verification.

blockers: Exact bootloader/SoftDevice identity and layout; confirmed J-Link/SWD installation alone does not establish factory UF2 identity.
Safe Dev Kit UART transport/entry, recovery protocol and NFC configuration (CH340C UART0 TX P0.08/RX P0.06).
Native USB reachability is unproven; do not treat CH340C USB-UART as UF2.
